marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Dora the explorer Dora's first trip

DVD features 4 episodes of Dora and her friend-filled adventures. "Dora's first trip": Join Dora's very first adventure and how she met Boots, Isa, Tico, Benny, the Fiesta Trio, and even that sneaky fox, Swiper! "Best friends": On best friends' day, Dora and Boots are meeting on Rainbow Rock, but they are in two different places. Help them on two separate adventures to get together again! "To the treehouse!": Dora and Boots are invited to a big treehouse party! To get there, they need to cross Crocodile Lake, climb a Stone Wall, and help their friends along the way! "The chocolate tree": Dora's Abuela misses the chocolate tree she had as a child. Dora and Boots set out to find it and bring back some chocolate. Help them through the Jungle and past Bear's cave!
